question: Identify the antonym of "Epitome"
solution:
The correct answer is: **4) Increment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Epitome"** means a perfect example of a particular quality or type; it represents the essence of something. (सारांश/प्रतिमान)
 
 
• **Example:** She is the epitome of kindness, always helping those in need.
 
 
• **"Increment"** refers to an increase or addition, especially one of a series on a fixed scale. It is the opposite of "Epitome" as it doesn’t refer to the essence or perfect example of something. (वृद्धि)
 
 
• **Example:** The employee received an annual increment in their salary.
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **"Epitome"** is **"Increment"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **4) Increment**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Example** (उदाहरण): A representative form or illustration of something.
 
 
• **Example:** This painting is a fine example of Renaissance art.
 
 
 
 
• **Summary** (सारांश): A brief statement or account of the main points of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher provided a summary of the lesson before the exam.
 
 
 
 
• **Essence** (सार): The intrinsic nature or indispensable quality of something that determines its character.
 
 
• **Example:** The essence of the story lies in its moral lesson.
